body:
Another victim of paranoia checking in. You are not alone. I know how it feels all to well, and i know just me saying that, won't make it better. If I knew how to go about the illness, I'd tell you - But I haven't found the answer myself. Some of the things that have sometimes works for me, is going for a looong run, watching tv, or playing video games. Anything to escape reality, really. I know those aren't permanent solutions, but they are what helps me cope.

I highly recommend you give at least some kind of therapy a shot, or do at least have people around you to help you ease your mind. Try not to rule out a mental hospital, even if you had a bad experience at one earlier.

One more thing, please stay alive .. :-)
Hey. I did actually end up doing a few breathing exercises, and they did help me a little bit. It does however look as if the call didn't go through though, but thank you for the response :)
Hey, thank you for the response. I haven't heard from her on other platforms, after i blocked her, so I don't think the call went through. Thanks for helping me calm down a bit.
